migration_flags.detail: hr.leave has no 'draft' state in v19. Default is 'confirm'. Any v16/v17 records in draft state must be migrated to confirm before import.

date_from and date_to on hr.leave are fully computed from request_date_from / request_date_to. Direct writes to date_from/date_to are rejected. Migration ETL must populate request_date_from / request_date_to instead.

hr.leave.type gains two new columns: allows_negative (Boolean) and max_allowed_negative (Integer). These do not exist in v16. Migration must set defaults (allows_negative=False, max_allowed_negative=0).
allocation_type on hr.leave.allocation is readonly=True after creation. Migration must set 'regular' or 'accrual' correctly on import; it cannot be corrected afterwards via UI.
hr.leave.report is still present as a SQL view in v19. It was NOT removed. No migration action required for the model itself.
can_be_carryover field on hr.leave.accrual.plan and hr.leave.accrual.level controls carry-over behaviour. New in this version family; check if prior accrual plan records need this set.

key_findings.state_machine: 5 states on hr.leave: confirm (default), refuse, validate1, validate, cancel. No draft. Allocation has 4: confirm, refuse, validate1, validate.
key_findings.approval_chain: leave_validation_type on hr.leave.type drives flow: no_validation | hr | manager | both. 'both' uses validate1 intermediate step. Officers (group_hr_holidays_user) have full access; leave_manager_id on employee grants targeted access.
key_findings.balance_computation: _compute_leaves delegates to employee._get_consumed_leaves() which aggregates approved allocations and pending+approved leaves per allocation into virtual_remaining_leaves / max_leaves.
key_findings.balance_enforcement: _check_validity() called on create/write. Blocks if no allocation exists. Allows overdraft up to max_allowed_negative when allows_negative=True on leave type.
key_findings.allocation_types: 2 types: regular (fixed grant) and accrual (via hr.leave.accrual.plan with multi-level schedule, 7 frequency options, carry-over and cap support).
key_findings.date_naming: v19 uses request_date_from/request_date_to as input (Date); date_from/date_to are computed Datetime stored fields. No holiday_date_from/holiday_date_to naming found in source.
key_findings.multicompany: company_id on hr.leave derived from employee.company_id. hr.leave.type.company_id optional; when set restricts access. Accrual plan company derived from leave type company.
key_findings.hr_leave_report: Still present as SQL view combining allocations and leave requests; uses date_from/date_to column names.
